name: splitwiser
description: Free forever, open-source group expense splitter. Zero friction, installable PWA, and no paywalls. Built for the things we share.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.deploy:landing: pnpm --filter landing build && wrangler pages deploy apps/landing/dist --project-name splitwiser-landing-production --branch main
scripts.deploy:dashboard: pnpm --filter dashboard build && wrangler pages deploy apps/dashboard/dist --project-name splitwiser-dashboard-production --branch main
scripts.deploy:api: pnpm --filter api db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc
